description: TrustBench: non-custodial routing and audit layer for x402. Returns a signed routing receipt with on-chain settlement reference, verifiable offline against a published Ed25519 key.

extra.description: TrustBench routing fee. Pays for the differentiated routing decision and signed routing receipt. Provider payment is a separate x402 transaction, paid directly to the provider after this call.
extra.name: USD Coin

_signals.x_guidance: TrustBench is a routing layer that wraps third-party x402 endpoints with signed receipts. Agents pay POST /route via the x402 paywall (per-call USDC settlement on Base through the Coinbase CDP facilitator). The 402 challenge advertises the price; on success the response includes an Ed25519-signed RoutingReceipt envelope retrievable forever at GET /receipts/{id}. Verify receipts offline with @trustbench/verify-receipt (npm) against the public key at /.well-known/trustbench-pubkey. Canonical discovery surfaces: /openapi.json (this file), /.well-known/trustbench.json (machine manifest), /skill.md (agentic.market format), /llms.txt (llmstxt.org format).
